intro: Hilary's Necklace is a cherished childhood keepsake lost beneath the surface of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. Given to young Hilary by her father, the trinket slipped into the murky waters while the children of Lakeshire were out fishing along the docks.

p: While fishing along the shoreline of Lakeshire with her friend Shawn, young Hilary accidentally dropped her treasured necklace into Lake Everstill. The heirloom holds immense sentimental value, having been a gift from her father. Fear of the fierce beasts and aggressive murlocs inhabiting the depths keeps the local children safely on the docks, leaving the necklace sunken and buried in the silt of the lakebed until an adventurer is willing to dive into the murky water to recover it.
